cluster: rhombic torus of 16 x 16 three-site unit cells, edge vectors 16 a1 and 16 a2 (a1 = (2, 0), a2 = (1, √3)), the pattern of kagome-8x8_192_P and kagome-12x12_432_P. Defined by arXiv:1712.04579: 'we consider toric clusters that are defined by T1 = La1 and T2 = La2, and thus consist of N = 3L2 sites' (Sec. I), 'All the clusters are of the type 3×L×L' (Tables S1, S2). The spin Hamiltonian is periodic; the 'mixed boundary conditions, i.e., anti-periodic along a1 and periodic along a2' of the table captions are those of the fermionic state before projection
